description: This file provides functions to send questions to a backend service, either via WebSocket streaming or REST API, with fallback mechanisms and utility functions for handling fetch and WebSocket interactions.

methods.name: askQuestion(prompt, context = {}, onDelta, signal)
methods.description: Sends a prompt to the backend, attempts WebSocket streaming if enabled, otherwise performs a REST POST request, with fallback and timeout handling.

methods.name: safeJson(res)
methods.description: Safely parses JSON from a fetch response, returns empty object on error.

methods.name: mergeAbortSignals(signalA, signalB)
methods.description: Combines two AbortSignals into one, aborts when either is aborted.

methods.name: streamViaWebSocket(url, onDelta, signal)
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to stream data, handles messages, errors, and cleanup.

ctags.name: askQuestion
ctags.pattern: /^export async function askQuestion(prompt, context = {}, onDelta, signal) {$/
